metadata.case_name: LEE YAM KAN v. NG PUI KUEN T/A WING SING SCAFFOLDING ENGINEERING AND ANOTHER

source: Examinations showed that he suffered an acute partial collapse L1 and bilateral fractured calcaneum.
Examinations showed that he suffered an acute partial collapse L1 and bilateral fractured calcaneum.

manifestations.description: heels pain (right more painful than left); pain more severe in early morning, start of walking, around sleep time and weather change; pain aggravated by walking for 45 minutes; wakes up at night due to pain
lower limb weakness (right worse than left)
difficulty in walking down stairs; cannot walk fast; avoids walking stairs and slopes
low back pain aggravated by sitting for 10 minutes and more severe during weather change; tenderness over mid-line L1 level and bilateral paraspinal muscles
poor balance when standing on right foot; can stand on left foot alone
cannot perform tip-toe/heel walking on both sides; can squat
power of left ankle full; power of right ankle slightly reduced; range of movement of right ankle poorer than left
X-ray of both ankles showed that the fracture united well with normal ankle alignment but there were degenerative changes in the subtalar joint of the right ankle
X-ray of the lumbar spine showed 20% collapse upper end plate of L1, mild kyphosis and mild degenerative changes
self-care and hygiene largely independent; avoids walking stairs and slopes

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation of bilateral fractured calcaneum (operation on 2011-03-25)
follow-up consultations at Orthopaedic clinic of UCH
consultation at Common Mental Disorder Clinic at EKPC (from about late May 2012)
treatments_future: medical treatment on a need-to basis

losses.description: Residual pain and stiffness in ankles and back with difficulty walking, difficulty walking down stairs, cannot walk fast, poor balance (especially right foot), cannot perform tip-toe/heel walking, difficulty in climbing, squatting and weight lifting; avoids stairs and slopes

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Chan Hung v Hang Yue Engineering Ltd & others
comparable_cases.injury_description: serious and continuing permanent disabilities from back and leg problems which were aggravated by his adjustment disorder, urinary symptoms and sexual dysfunction

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Cheuk Leung v Erawin Co Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of L1 lumbar vertebrae, fracture of the calcaneum bones of both feet, and fracture of the distal phalanx of right toe (plaintiff did not need to undergo any operation)
